recommendation.wire: one authenticated TLS/h2 connection per USB data session, stream1 only, bounded fixed CONNECT
recommendation.negotiation: strict ALPN rustusb-usbip/2/config2; existing raw-v1/schema1 retained without fallback
recommendation.owner: Link{io,owner,monitor}; owner stop+join mandatory; monitor no TLS/lease/permit
recommendation.receive: owned pump -> fixed65535B duplex; h2 credit only exact actual app-read delta, received_total published before exposing bytes
recommendation.flush: Root TrackingIo local encoded headers only; complete stream1 DATA offset then actual TLS poll_flush; independent zero-FIN fence
recommendation.rtt: one pending fixed h2 USER ping; enqueue to matching library pong elapsed; local seq is not a wire nonce
recommendation.logging: quiet scoped NoSubscriber around all h2 calls/polls/Ready mappings/Drops; no raw h2 Display/Debug
recommendation.integration: driver independent of WAL/app reads; relay itself ended-select while kernel write blocked; actual helper cleanup and Root proof remain distinct

must_freeze_before_implementation: Root exact trusted config2 names/ranges and TLS new v2 methods
fixed CONNECT authority/method and allowed headers
final DTO names and snapshot semantics with I
optional FlushMonitor real write_pending snapshot hook
scope_limits: No repository modifications by reviewer, Cargo, CLI, compile, tests, QEMU or USB operations.
Design/API declaration sheet was not compiled and is not runtime verification.
Four reviewed RustSec advisories covered by0.4.20 does not constitute transitive cargo-audit.
PING/PONG endpoint response is not USB completion or DATA consumption proof.
65535B logical payload bound is not exact process RSS.
Half-close preserves foreground drain versus managed first-EOF policy; errors/timeout are not clean EOF.
Root authored proposed design and flush/lib in-flight changes independently; current whole worktree is not claimed clean.
